name: 乌拉塔（极夜的样子）
evolution: 乌达（极夜的样子） → 迷你乌（极夜的样子） Lv.30 → 乌拉塔（极夜的样子） Lv.50
description: 天冷的时候是它们最喜欢的恶作剧时刻，偷偷用冰冷的爪子塞进小洛克的脖子里。当能量满溢之后，同伴之间会互相投掷蕴含冰系魔法的冷笑话，看上去就像在打雪仗。
descriptionEn: Cold weather is their favorite time for mischief, secretly slipping icy claws into little Lockes' necks. When their energy overflows, they throw Ice-magic-infused corny jokes at each other, looking as if they are having a snowball fight.

skills.name: 冰锥
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 雾气环绕
skills.description: 回复能量，回复值等于敌方技能总能耗的一半。
skills.descriptionEn: Restore energy equal to half of the enemy's total skill energy cost.

skills.name: 诋毁
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 当头棒喝
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次技能威力+100。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the enemy switched spirits this turn, this skill's power +100.

skills.name: 丢冰块
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得速度-30。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains Speed -30.

skills.name: 恶意逃离
skills.description: 脱离，应对防御：额外使敌方攻击技能能耗+4。
skills.descriptionEn: Escape; if responding to Defense, additionally makes the enemy's attacking skills cost +4 energy.

skills.name: 趁火打劫
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，若击败敌方，本技能连击数永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2-hit combo; if it defeats the enemy, this skill's combo count permanently +2.

skills.name: 冰晶坠
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains all-skill energy cost +1.

skills.name: 极限撕裂
skills.description: 造成物伤，若自己生命高于50%，使用后自己获得双攻-50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if your HP is above 50%, you gain both attacks -50% after use.

skills.name: 滚雪球
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得2层冻结，应对状态：额外获得2层，本次技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains 2 stacks of Freeze; if responding to a status, gains 2 extra stacks and this skill's power is doubled.

skills.name: 暗突袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，吸血50%，应对状态：本次技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 50% lifesteal; if responding to a status, this skill's power is doubled.
